input.quote: A. No Application Management Revenue shall be due for any Corio Customer subscriptions utilizing the initial 3000 Software User licenses granted herein, subject to a minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer
input.rationale: There is no take-or-pay, volume commitment or shortfall payment binding us: fees are fixed licence, maintenance and MarketSite access fees plus a revenue share on actual Customer revenue, and implementation work is time-and-materials capped. The "minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer" only sets the boundary of the revenue-share exemption for the pre-paid 3,000 user licences; it does not oblige us to purchase volume, and Software Users are unlimited.

input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11.3 gives useful continuity (surviving licence, surviving support and Section 12 escrow) but contains no transition assistance and no obligation on Commerce One to return or export our and our Customers' data held in the MarketSite.net Service, nor any deletion certification. For a hosted arrangement that absence is a deviation, so we insert a fallback-level transition and data-return paragraph.
